thread:
Maya R: quick design check — updated invite flow mock (attached). main concerns: roles density in the drawer, how SSO toggle copy reads for org admins, and a shortcut to jump to relevant audit-log events.
Tom L: pinging for UX input. can we reduce vertical density in the roles grid? it feels crowded at 6 roles.
Anne P: Agree. Two suggestions: 1) compact rows with hover-to-expand for permissions; 2) collapse less-used roles under a "More" chevron.
Maya R: option 1 feels better for keyboard users — hover expansion isn't accessible by default. maybe we do focus/hover both.
Kevin S: agree on focus support. also we should show role purpose inline, not only in tooltip. small one-line subtitle under role name.
Anne P: copy idea for subtitle: "Controls inference access & model pinning" — short and scannable.
Tom L: on SSO toggle — current label: `Enforce SSO` — product wants clearer phrasing for admins who aren't security-savvy.
Maya R: proposed alternatives: "Require SSO for org sign-in", "Restrict sign-in to SSO only", "Enable SSO enforcement" — which reads best?
Anne P: "Require SSO for org sign-in" is explicit but long. maybe shorten to "Require SSO for org" and add a tooltip that explains: "All users must sign in via your configured SSO provider." 
Kevin S: accessibility nit: the toggle needs aria-describedby pointing to that explanatory text. Also keyboard state label should be read as "SSO required" vs "SSO optional" — avoid verbs that sound like an action.
Maya R: good call. I'll write the aria copy: `aria-label="SSO enforcement" aria-checked-desc="SSO required for org sign-in" aria-unchecked-desc="SSO optional"`
Tom L: can we show a small inline warning when enabling SSO explaining immediate effects (e.g., existing tokens? existing sessions?).
Maya R: yes — mock shows a transient inline banner: "Enabling SSO will sign out users who don't have SSO-linked accounts; existing sessions persist for 30 minutes unless revoked." short + link to docs.
Anne P: audit log jump — users asked for a quick "show invites & role changes" filter. propose a pill on top: `Filters: All | Invites | Role changes | SSO config`.
Kevin S: add keyboard shortcut: press `g` then `a` to go to Audit and open the "Role changes" filter.
Tom L: for microcopy alternatives in invite modal CTA — current: `Send invite` vs `Invite & set role`. Users were confused about whether they could update role later.
Maya R: suggestion: primary `Send invite` and a secondary `Send & assign role`. Tooltip: "You can change roles later in Org settings".
Anne P: accessibility: ensure modals trap focus and the role dropdown is accessible via arrow keys; announce role help text when focused.
aria-bot: reminder: design doc updated at https://redwood.design/r/org-invite-usability (auto-post) :pushpin:
Tom L: nit on roles grid: add a visible keyboard focus ring color that's high-contrast (not the current pale blue). use #0b5fff or similar.
Maya R: I'll iterate the mock with the compact row, inline subtitle, aria props, and the audit-filter pill. will post a new PNG shortly.
Anne P: LGTM, but let's run this by support to validate common admin questions wording before finalizing copy.
Kevin S: can someone add a tiny acceptance checklist? a11y, keyboard nav, tooltip copy, audit filter shortcut, SSO aria strings.
Maya R: adding checklist to the ticket now.
Tom L: thanks — good progress. :thumbsup:
